summary: Co-Diagnostics filed an 8-K disclosing an inducement agreement with holders of existing warrants. Holders agreed to exercise warrants for 1,702,362 shares at $1.571 per share, yielding ~$2.67 million gross, in exchange for new warrants to purchase 3,404,724 shares at $1.56 per share. The new warrants are not exercisable until stockholder approval per Nasdaq rules. Maxim Group LLC acted as placement agent, receiving a 7% cash fee and $50,000 expense reimbursement. Closing expected on August 3, 2026. Proceeds will fund general corporate purposes. Watch for stockholder approval and potential dilution from new warrants.
